title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1559: Great deceit king (3)

section.p: Experts were arriving one after another. Some would help Su Yu while some would help the myriad races.
As for Su Yu, he only had one thought in his mind: opening the death tunnel and fleeing.
Holy shit!
He had nearly died.
The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor had acted.

The Dragon Pseudo Emperor might take part as well. He was most likely waiting for a better opportunity to act. And at that point, escaping might no longer be possible. Just as Su Yu was about to start his escape, the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor looked forth in surprise.
Biting sounds rang out from the empty air he was staring at. Abruptly, a gigantic figure emerged out of thin air. The newcomer seemed to be chewing on something unknown.

While chewing, the newcomer smiled and said, “You can’t kill Su Yu! Not long ago, the laws of our great ancestor reacted to something. Su Yu seems to have completed the seventy-two forgings of my race. Therefore, you are not allowed to kill him.”
“Iron devourer…”
The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor was greatly shaken.
The iron devourers had picked a side this epoch. Why?
He asked, “Why? The iron devourers had remained neutral even during the ninth epoch with that man around. Why choose Su Yu? I don’t understand.”

The gigantic iron devourer flashed a silly smile and said, “Because…that man didn’t complete the seventy-two forgings. I only know one thing. Since Su Yu has completed the 72-Forged Iron Devourer, he is our ally. He can’t deny that since he cultivates the cultivation method of my race.”
Su Yu hurriedly nodded his head in agreement.
Holy shit!

Yes! He would accept this! He could even call that giant bear his daddy if that was enough to secure their help. What a surprise. This was truly a surprise. He had been planning to flee when a fat–cough, cough, a super expert dropped down from the sky.
What a pleasant surprise.

The Iron Devourer Pseudo Emperor continued chewing on something. Only then did some people notice what he was chewing. Numerous people shivered at the sight of that. He was eating a dragon. A large dragon.
It merely looked small in his hand. And it was still alive. The Iron Devourer Pseudo Emperor was eating a dragon alive.
An Invincible dragon.

With the same silly smile on his face, the Iron Devourer Pseudo Emperor said, “Su Yu said that the immortals are delicious. I disagree. The dragons taste better. I’m serious. The dragons taste great. I have always loved eating dragons. Their livers taste even better. Of course, Tiangu might really be delicious. I still remember that fragrance not long ago…but he won’t be that easy to eat.”
Just then, the big furball’s voice rang out, “Fatty! Old Turtle! Can we switch opponents? Jiwu tastes bad! He stinks! I want to fight Tiangu with my wife!”
He was sick of his stinky opponent. He much preferred Tiangu.
“No thanks.”
“Nope.”
The big furball was displeased. In his fury, a massive ball replaced the sky above them. Above the ball was a black hole, or to be precise, a mouth.
The big furball roared, “I am angry! Jiwu and the others have angered me! I will eat both the Divine and Nether Realms!”
“Wife, eat their realms!”

Then, the entire sky was replaced by two boundlessly large mouths. Under everyone’s shocked gazes, the two abandoned their initial opponents. Their initial opponents were too annoying. They had decided to eat the homes of their opponents instead.
The two mouths continued growing. Eventually, they grew large enough to reach the Divine and Nether Realms. The expressions of the Divine and Nether Pseudo Emperors changed as they cursed.
Damn it!
These lunatics! They had nobody to lose except the one with Su Yu. When they were annoyed enough, they would start killing indiscriminately since they had nothing to lose.

The two hurriedly rushed back to their respective realms to stop the two large mouths. Unlike the two furballs, everyone else had too many to lose. If the two were allowed to swallow their realms, even if they couldn’t digest the realms, countless people inside the realms would die.
The losses would be disastrous.
Su Yu was greatly amazed by what he saw.

He started patting the little furball in his head, promising to treat the little fellow well in the future. The little fellow’s Dada and Mama were simply too impressive. And they had nothing to lose. They were completely unlike Great Qin King and the others, who had many things to consider before doing anything.
How terrifying. If anyone else dared to try the same, they would be met with the same action as retribution. However, that wasn’t possible with the two furballs.
“Pay attention!”
Wan Tiansheng berated him. What was this kid doing? Even now, they were still surrounded by multiple Invincibles. Was the kid trying to die by blanking out in such a situation?

Su Yu sighed and said, “How amazing. If I were this amazing, I would definitely slaughter those in the Divine, Devil, and Immortal Realms as well. I will turn them all into snacks for the Iron Devourer and Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperors.”

He said it nonchalantly, but the surrounding Invincibles shivered at his words. He spoke with an incredibly light tone, as though he was joking. But they could feel that this might not necessarily be a joke. They could totally see him doing that.
In the entirety of the Myriad Realms, very few people could compare against Su Yu in viciousness and ruthlessness.
Suddenly, Su Yu shouted, “Now, Head!”
At that, the pavilion Invincibles shook slightly. Was there another traitor among them?

With a rumble, the second body of the first enforcer elder was blasted apart by Su Yu. Wan Tiansheng followed with a swing of his sword, cutting the River of Time apart. The first enforcer elder was forced to return faster, only to be met with Wan Tiansheng’s palm. He died.
Silence descended.

Nine Invincibles had died so far. Su Yu and Wan Tiansheng had killed four of them. Prior to that, Su Yu had also killed four with the assistance of the guardians. Meanwhile, Great Qin King had only killed one.

Even knowing that Su Yu had employed trickery in his kills, the various Invincibles still distanced themselves from each other in fear. They were still wary. After all, the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion had produced too many traitors. They couldn’t help but be wary. Trust between them had been destroyed.

If the heads of the West Spire, Profound Department, and Yellow Department could defect, who could say that there weren’t more? Nothing was more important than their own lives. Far away, the Heavenly Overseer Marquis sighed with regret. He felt very helpless.
Even if he were to declare that there were no traitors left, nobody would trust him. After all, too many traitors had appeared.
Even Tiangu was losing his temper as he cursed in rage, “Are all of them so useless? There were over twenty of them yet they can’t even kill only two non-Eternals?”

He was bursting with rage. He was patient, but this was too infuriating. What was this? The Eternals they deployed for this were enough to kill even a ninth-degree Eternal. How did they fail to defeat Su Yu and Wan Tiansheng? Multiple Daofuses had been forced to act this time, but they had still failed.
Tiangu asked, “Dragon Pseudo Emperor, are you not doing anything?”

He could no longer rely on the Eternals. They were too disappointing. How? How did they fail when there were so many of them? One had fled, one had lost a tri-life body, while the remaining fourteen were fighting half-heartedly.

If they had tried a tiny bit harder, the first enforcer elder wouldn’t have died. But none of them had tried to save the first enforcer elder. They merely watched on as the elder was killed. Were they here to fight or were they here to sightsee? At this point, Tiangu could only place his hope on the Dragon Pseudo Emperor.

Could the humans produce someone capable of handling the Dragon Pseudo Emperor? The appearance of the Iron Devourer Pseudo Emperor was surprising as well. After all, he had stayed neutral for nine epochs. Why did he act this time? He had claimed that he did it for the 72-Forged Iron Devourer, but nobody knew if that was the real reason.
Then again, it did not matter. Balance would be restored after Su Yu’s death. A majority of these helpers had appeared for Su Yu, not humanity. It was clear how important Su Yu was.
Near Eastrift Valley.
Great Zhou King watched in silence. He was also surprised at the sight of so many helpers, such as the Iron Devourer Pseudo Emperor.

He had never imagined this happening. As for Tiangu, his coffin had been stopped by the old turtle. Tiangu himself was still hiding in the Immortal Realm. Great Zhou King looked in the direction of the Dragon Realm. Would the Dragon Pseudo Emperor act as well? He was unsure, but the likelihood was quite high.
After a short silence, Great Zhou King manifested a character. At the same time, a black hole appeared in the sky.
He looked at the other human Invincibles and said, “Get on it. Do not resist. Now.”
The Invincibles looked at Great Zhou King solemnly. One of them asked, “A transportation character?”
“Get on it.”

Great Zhou King did not answer, causing the Invincibles to hesitate. Even so, they did as told and stepped on the black hole. Great Zhou King continued, “When we reach our destination, start killing indiscriminately. Thirty seconds. Return to the character again after that regardless of what’s happening. Do you understand me?”
Great Yuan King said with an awkward expression, “Old Zhou, can you change your appearance before talking? Even your character is out. Why are you still keeping your disguise?”
Great Zhou King chuckled, “Old Qin looks a lot more ferocious. Stop wasting time. Let’s do it.”
Before long, all of them were on the black hole.

Great Zhou King manifested another character, covering all of them with it. Instantly, all their presences vanished. That was a character similar to the calm character in function. With a wave of his hand, he manifested over twenty other characters. Each of these characters was emanating a powerful aura, but they also felt rather weak for some reason. All of them transformed into the appearance of the various human Invincibles.

With another wave of Great Zhou King’s hand, all of them shot toward the immortal border, looking as though they were going to exert more pressure on the immortals. The human Invincibles watched in silence and shock. This geezer had an incredibly large number of tricks up his sleeves.

Not even Great Qin King was comparable…no, that was unfair. Apart from swinging his spear, Great Qin King knew nothing. Then, Great Zhou King waited silently. After about a minute, he activated the teleportation. Next, everyone appeared before a realm entrance.
“Kill!”
Great Zhou King wasted no time and killed the Invincible guarding the entrance with a palm strike. The other Invincibles did not even have the time to determine their location.
They started killing.
In such a situation, they only needed to follow their military orders.
After killing the Invincible guarding the entrance, Great Zhou King stepped through it and sent a palm attack downward. A massive city was instantly flattened alongside countless dragons.

Only then did the others notice that they were in the Dragon Realm. Not far from the Dragon Realm, the Dragon Pseudo Emperor was just about to join the battle. Suddenly, he roared, transformed into a gigantic dragon, and returned to the Dragon Realm.
Meanwhile, Tiangu looked in the Eastrift Valley’s direction, staring through space itself. But he saw over twenty human Invincibles waiting there.
He blanked out.
What was going on?

In the Dragon Realm, numerous Invincibles attacked indiscriminately, completely unaffected by the suppressive force. One Mountainsea dragon after another died. One Sunmoon dragon after another died. In the blink of an eye, thousands upon thousands died.
This was too sudden.

A dragon Invincible, who was approaching the human Invincibles, hurriedly turned around to flee. But he was blasted apart in the blink of an eye. He had been thoroughly killed before he could even react.
Two Invincibles had died just like that. Far away, numerous dragon Invincibles soared into the sky with horrified expressions.
“The humans are attacking!”
Countless dragons wailed in fear and panic. Chaos engulfed the Dragon Realm.
Suddenly, Great Zhou King shouted, “Get back on the character!”
All the Invincibles did as told.

Great Zhou King stepped through the realm entrance and vanished with a hum. Immediately after, the Dragon Pseudo Emperor arrived. When he went through the entrance and laid eyes on the Dragon Realm, he roared in fury. It had been less than thirty seconds.

In such a short time, the dragon race had lost two Invincibles, hundreds of Sunmoons, and countless dragons below that realm. The two cities near the realm entrance had been completely flattened. Nothing was left.
“Humans!”
The Dragon Pseudo Emperor roared with boundless fury.
Humans.
With a flicker, Great Zhou King reappeared at the Eastrift Valley with the other Invincibles.
Many of them had blank expressions.
What did they do earlier?
This was too sudden.

They had appeared outside the Dragon Realm, entered, slaughtered, flattened cities…before returning. Was that it? They still couldn’t process what they just did. All of them stared at Great Zhou King in shock. This fellow…was a tad bit too terrifying.

Meanwhile, Great Zhou King said nothing. He looked in the Dragon Realm’s direction silently. He was daring the Dragon Pseudo Emperor to try joining the battle without saying it. He didn’t even need to say anything. He only needed to make sure the Dragon Pseudo Emperor wouldn’t have the courage to join the battle.

This was also a warning to the other Pseudo Emperors. He was daring all of them to join the battle. In fact, he was also pressuring the Pseudo Emperors already in the battle, such as the celestial chasm, such as Tiangu, such as the nether…

They better be careful. He was capable of transporting dozens of Invincibles anywhere instantly. Any realm without the protection of its Pseudo Emperor had the risk of being slaughtered. They had merely killed two Invincibles in the short invasion, but that short invasion was comparable to killing a Pseudo Emperor.

The various Daofuses were overwhelmed with shock. It occurred to them that Great Zhou King…possessed the ability to transport a large number of people instantaneously, and he was capable of doing it across massive distances.
The range he could cover was too big. An excessive amount of strength was required to withstand the pressure associated with transporting so many Invincibles. How did he even accomplish that?

Great Zhou King continued standing there expressionlessly. Nobody should bother asking. He would not answer. It didn’t matter if he had harmed himself doing that. More importantly, was he scary? Was he scary enough for them?
Yes? Good. That was enough.

Beneath his calm exterior, underneath his robes, numerous cracks appeared on his skin. However, his blood would vanish right after seeping out, keeping his robes completely clean. He looked in the Immortal Realm’s direction, as though he was meeting Tiangu’s gaze and daring Tiangu to leave.
Su Yu was shocked. Wan Tiansheng was blanking out.

Since when was Great Zhou King…so amazing? They were prepared to flee right after the Dragon Pseudo Emperor arrived. But once again, they had been stopped from fleeing. Would the Dragon Pseudo Emperor still have the courage to leave after that?
In the blink of an eye, the dragons had lost three Invincibles, including the one who had died earlier.
Up until now, eleven Invincibles had died.
Su Yu sent a voice transmission, “Principal, I think we don’t need to run anymore.”

Why should they run now? Each time he thought they should run, something would happen to remove the need to run. Reality itself was telling them to stay. Great Zhou King’s timing was simply too perfect, as though he had completely predicted the Dragon Pseudo Emperor’s reaction beforehand.
Su Yu suddenly had a feeling that Great Zhou King was actually stronger than even Great Qin King. That was applicable for both brains and brawn.

That short mission had been carried out without any casualties on humanity’s side. Meanwhile, it was effective as having a Daofuse. Or perhaps it was even more effective than having a Daofuse. Even now, the Dragon Pseudo Emperor was still roaring in fury.

Su Yu could hear the helplessness and fury in those roars. The Dragon Pseudo Emperor no longer dared to leave. Yes, they still had many Invincibles inside, but so what? They might lose a few more Invincibles if the Dragon Pseudo Emperor dared to leave again, bringing their losses near the level of the immortals.
“Wow. The Great Deceit King sure is impressive…”
As Su Yu muttered in admiration, Wan Tiansheng coughed awkwardly. The kid should watch his mouth. No matter what, Great Zhou King had stopped a Pseudo Emperor for him.
